purpose: Evaluate a frozen extended analyzer once, without tuning on held-out results

malicious_selection.procedure: sort package directories, fixed-seed shuffle, select first requested packages, sort ZIPs <=25MiB in each complete subtree, fixed-seed choose one ZIP; retain acquisition errors and do not replace after inspection

separation: package-disjoint; family/campaign disjointness is not established
protocol: Acquire encrypted samples and record exact paths/hashes before analyzer tuning; do not decrypt/analyze holdout until candidate frozen; preserve every result; no candidate changes after viewing holdout scores
